name: Aerodynamic Part Quality
description: Geometric deviation of manufactured aerodynamic parts. Checks whether lift coefficient stays above required value.

elements.name: Aerodynamic Profile Deviation
elements.description: Deviation from nominal CAD geometry due to manufacturing and template wear.

elements.name: Required Lift Coefficient
elements.description: Lift coefficient at nominal geometry with 1.2mm tolerance

consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ(δ_profile) = C_L_nominal + α·δ_profile, α ≈ -0.05 per mm deviation
consistency_relations.upr_description: The lift coefficient is an affine function of the profile deviation: C_L(δ) ≈ C_L₀ + α·δ where α < 0 (deviation reduces lift). This parametric mapping scales the geometric uncertainty set into the aerodynamic performance domain, where it must remain above C_L_req.
